notes.title: DEMO PATCH NOTES #1 – A Special Thanks to Our… Fallen Couriers
notes.content:
We’ve been very busy patching up Panic Delivery, thanks to the invaluable contributions of all the couriers who… well, didn’t make it. 
Your sacrifices (and spectacularly horrible deaths) have helped us track down and squash some nasty bugs—so, in a way, you didn’t die for nothing! ❤️💀

What’s new in this hotfix?

 Fixed an issue where players would occasionally stretch into eldritch horrors when impaled. We get it, you wanted to be more flexible, but this was too much.
 Various UI navigation issues resolved. Now you can panic efficiently!
 Added a prompt when leaving the shop without selecting a single item in the loadout tab. Because running into a death trap empty-handed isn’t exactly smart.
 Fixed an issue where the Pack Eater enemy sometimes forgot to return eaten packages upon death. Turns out, even monsters can be bad at customer service.
 Resolved an audio issue that was playing sounds at the wrong times.* Screams of terror should be appropriately timed, after all.*
 Fixed a bug that was preventing voice chat from working under specific circumstances. Now you can properly scream for help—and let your teammates hear your final words.

Your feedback (and tragic demises) are crucial to making Panic Delivery even better, so keep those reports coming… and try to stay in one piece! 

See you in the chaos, couriers—assuming you survive. 💀

Visit our Website

notes.title: Deliver. Survive. Repeat. Invader Studios is Ready to Drop Its New Horror Comedy
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478837/ad516ea6f001a7a7fbe78fd3bc991ec428eadbc1.jpg

JOIN THE DISCORD SERVER NOW!

Invader Studios is thrilled to announce Panic Delivery, a chaotic multiplayer co-op horror comedy where players take on the role of desperate couriers struggling to complete perilous deliveries in a post-apocalyptic world ruled by monsters. In this brutal reality, humans are nothing more than expendable workers, assigned to the most dangerous jobs.

The game is expected to launch in Early Access on Steam in Q2 2025.

With procedurally generated dungeons, deadly traps, and terrifying clients, survival is just as important as the job—because failure means becoming the next sacrifice.

The game is officially revealed with a brand-new announcement trailer, alongside the launch of its Steam page and Discord community, where players can stay updated, interact with the developers, and prepare for the ultimate courier experience.

Demo Coming to Steam Next Fest!

Curious to see if you have what it takes to survive? Players will get a first taste of the madness as Panic Delivery will be featured with a playable demo at the upcoming Steam Next Fest. Get ready to test your survival instincts, master procedural dungeons, and prove your worth to your monstrous employers.

Deliver or Die Trying!📦🚚💀

What is Panic Delivery?

A Multiplayer Co-op Horror Comedy – Join forces with up to 3 friends or take on the madness solo as you try to complete absurd delivery missions in a world ruled by monstrous overlords.

Procedurally Generated Dungeons – No two missions are the same. Every contract drops you into randomized, shifting environments filled with deadly traps, aggressive monsters, and ever-changing hazards.

Deliver or Die Trying – Your job is simple: transport packages to horrifying clients before you get caught, crushed, or consumed and get your reward back.
The challenge? The world is actively trying to kill you. 

Full Character Customization – Design your expendable courier with a variety of outfits, gear, and cosmetic items to bring some personal flair to the apocalypse.

Dark Humor Meets Brutal Chaos – The absurdity of expendable couriers risking their lives for monstrous customers creates a perfect mix of tension, comedy, and relentless action.
Wishlist Now & Join the Community!

The Steam page is now live, so players can wishlist Panic Delivery to stay updated on its development and be among the first to dive into this brutal delivery nightmare.
